en: N=1, no control—this is where "feels faster" is born

en: De-identify corpus before it hits the cloud; raw is audio / cases / PRD / journeys—not the recruit list

zh: 寫進 wiki 的是可執行 prompt + schema，不是聊天窗裡的一次性貼文
en: Wiki gets executable prompt + schema, not a one-off paste from chat

zh: 寫回 Wiki + 對外交付
en: Write back to wiki + ship out

zh: 問卷／Keynote 有出處；行為紀錄回 log.md，否則下輪無交叉引用
en: Surveys / Keynote have provenance; behavior logs go to log.md, or next round has no cross-ref

zh: 本機轉錄訪談與放聲思考錄音,語料不出機器
en: Transcribe interviews/think-aloud locally; corpus never leaves the machine

zh: 依旅程 prompt 扮演用戶跑螢幕操作／對抗檢查
en: Play the user from the journey prompt: screen ops / adversarial checks

前期易用性外測 pilot 場次

en: Outsourced static mocks / deck visual hours

en: Auto-generate / export surveys from behavior logs

en: Turn loop results into a stakeholder deck

en: EPSS 2 → 3 · ③④ are EPSS 4 spillover; talk only demos them

zh: 打開 T4 旅程 prompt 模板,把「角色/任務/情境限制/成功條件」四個欄位換成你的個案內容—只改欄位,不動結構。

蒸餾的邊界 · 知識歸屬與透明度
en: Distill boundary · Knowledge ownership and transparency

zh: 可自由蒸餾(附正確出處)
組織內可;離職帶走需授權
en: OK in-org; taking it on exit needs a license

zh: 依合約,預設歸客戶;帶走需約定
en: By contract, defaults to client; taking it needs a clause

zh: 未經改寫與去識別化不得入教材
en: Stay out of teaching materials until rewritten and de-identified

zh: 視聘僱合約(工作時間產出條款)
哪些資料進入哪個模型;是否雲端處理;是否用於訓練;留存與刪除方式。
en: What data enters which model; cloud or not; used for training; retention and deletion.

zh: AI 生成/人工修訂的大致比例;最終人工審核者與審核範圍。
en: Rough AI-generate / human-edit split; who did final review, and of what.

zh: 本案知識是否進入承接方之個人知識庫;範圍、去識別化方式與客戶同意紀錄。
en: Did this project's knowledge enter the contractor's personal knowledge base; scope, de-identification, client consent on file.

zh: 操作步驟 · 邊界標注三步
en: How-to · Three steps to mark the boundary

zh: EPSS 1 → 3 · 決策者可直接跳步驟 1 推行
en: EPSS 1 → 3 · Decision-makers can skip to step 1 and ship it

zh: 下載揭露範本(D2),照四個欄位填一份你目前手上專案的版本。填不出來的欄位,就是你的治理盲點—這一步不需要任何工具能力。
en: Download the disclosure template (D2). Fill all four fields for a project you have now. Blank fields are your governance blind spots—no tool skill required.

zh: 誰為知識歸屬與透明度負責 · 組織 RACI
en: Who is accountable for knowledge ownership and transparency · Org RACI

zh: 活動 · 知識歸屬／透明度
帶走什麼 · 從範本到制度化物件
en: What you leave with · From template to institutional objects

zh: 形式 · 對四欄的作用
en: Form · What it does to the four fields

zh: 邊界矩陣(三種身份 × 蒸餾標的)
決策牆／wiki 首頁—回答「能不能蒸餾」
en: Decision wall / wiki home—answers "can I distill this?"

zh: markdown／一頁紙—工具·資料·審核·蒸餾
本專案揭露聲明(填好的 D2 實例)
附在交付物—透明度可被審核
義務寫進紙—乙方必附 D3
en: Obligation on paper—vendor must attach D3

zh: RACI 人名—每列一個 A
對照矩陣第二列—灰帶必授權
en: Matrix row 2—grey zone needs a license

zh: 機敏資料禁入規則(一句 SOP)
紅線書面化—對四欄「資料流向」
en: Red line in writing—binds the Data-flow field

zh: 操作步驟 · 制度化三步(接 §05)
EPSS 0 → 3 · 決策者可停在步驟 1–2
en: EPSS 0 → 3 · Decision-makers can stop at steps 1–2

zh: 指定 §06 兩格 A(揭露推行、交付附聲明),並下載／複製 D2 範本進你們的範本庫。
en: Name the two §06 A's (roll out disclosure; attach the statement on delivery). Copy D2 into your template library.

zh: 下一份發包或內部交付,把「必附 D3」寫進檢核項或合約附件清單(D5)。
en: On the next contract or internal handoff, put "D3 required" on the checklist or contract-annex list (D5).

zh: 執行端啟用 D4(distill:)與 D7(結案帶走)—讓邊界從「聽過矩陣」變成「寫入時擋得住」。
en: Operators turn on D4 (distill:) and D7 (close-out takeaway)—boundary moves from "heard the matrix" to "blocked on write".

zh: 管理判斷補充 · 白話版 · EPSS 1–5 · 接 §05–§07
en: Management-judgment add-on · Plain talk · EPSS 1–5 · Follows §05–§07

zh: 現場主講用 · 不必先會寫 prompt · 決策者可只聽判準與收斂
en: For live delivery · No prompt-writing required · Decision-makers can listen only for criteria and convergence

zh: 7.1 · 同一功能 × 四種產品形態
白話版 · 四張卡片：長怎樣／卡在哪／跟 AI 必講什麼
en: Plain talk · Four cards: how it looks / where you stall / what you must tell AI

zh: 像 iOS／Android 設定裡的子頁：一排開關、分組列表、單欄往下捲
en: Like an iOS/Android Settings subpage: toggles, grouped lists, single column, scroll down

zh: 系統推播權限要先問過；螢幕很窄；按鈕要夠大才點得準（約拇指大小）
en: Ask push permission first; screen is narrow; tap targets need thumb size

zh: 這是 iOS 還是 Android、推播權限怎麼開、多台裝置要不要同步
en: iOS or Android; how push permission opens; whether devices sync

zh: 設定頁、郵件偏好中心；常靠 cookie／帳號記住你的選擇
en: Settings page, email preference center; often cookie/account remembers choices

zh: Chrome／Safari 行為不一；多半沒有真正的手機推播；手機／平板／桌面斷點長得不一樣
en: Chrome/Safari diverge; usually no real mobile push; phone/tablet/desktop breakpoints look different

zh: 主要在哪幾個螢幕寬度看、用哪家寄信、退訂／個資要合規
en: Which widths you design for; which mailer; unsubscribe / PII must comply

zh: 管理員設定 + 可覆寫到個人；大量勾選、表格操作
en: Admin defaults + per-user override; bulk checkboxes, table ops

zh: 不同角色預設不同；客戶與客戶資料要隔離；誰改過什麼通常要留稽核紀錄
en: Defaults differ by role; tenant data stays isolated; who changed what usually needs an audit log

zh: 有哪些角色、租戶邊界在哪、合規／稽核要記到什麼程度
en: Which roles; where the tenant boundary sits; how deep compliance/audit must go

zh: 常常沒有傳統設定頁；用白話跟助手說「幫我關掉行銷通知」、靠聰明預設
en: Often no settings page; tell the assistant "turn off marketing notices" and lean on smart defaults

zh: 沒有固定畫面可回看；對話記不住太久；它「以為記得」但其實不可靠
en: No stable screen to revisit; chat forgets; it "thinks it remembers" and doesn't

zh: 對話要記哪些、什麼時候改回一般畫面操作、重要設定要不要再確認一次
en: What chat must persist; when to fall back to a normal UI; whether critical settings need a confirm

zh: 7.2 · AI 多方案工作流 · 五步收斂
從需求文件拆出「可單獨驗證」的最小功能，拿掉華麗形容詞，留下可測的一句話。
en: From the brief, split a smallest independently testable feature. Strip adjectives. Leave one testable sentence.
